correctedFields.value: Strongest feature: The principle assigns affirmative justificatory responsibility, restricts its conclusion to warranted belief rather than divine nonexistence, and connects argument plus evidence with the motion’s governing epistemic demand. Principal limitation: As a reply, it redirects around the closure challenge instead of determining whether sensitivity-based skepticism defeats derivative knowledge, while leaving its own evidential norm undefended against properly basic entitlement. Live burden: The position must specify sufficient positive justification while accommodating fallible inference, testimony, and foundational commitments, without transforming evidential responsibility into an unattainable requirement for deductive demonstration. Locked score: The strong band reflects exceptional burden relevance, terminological stability, calibrated scope, and coherent responsibility allocation, tempered by restricted responsiveness and incomplete defense of the justificatory standard.

Strongest feature: The domino illustration makes the affirmative’s cosmological route recoverable by connecting regress termination, causal initiation, and movement from causation toward conscious agency. Principal limitation: The analogy slides among temporal succession, modal conceivability, metaphysical necessity, and consciousness without proving equivalence, while its necessity claim outruns demonstration from imagining an infinite sequence. Live burden: The case must establish why an actual infinite cannot contain a present member, why causal concepts legitimately extend beyond the universe, and why an ultimate ground excludes impersonal necessity or disposition. Locked score: The mixed band preserves central burden contact, constructive importance, and structure, while registering material scope instability, inadequate evidential warrant, missing qualification, and the unsupported transition from causal ultimacy to conscious will.
